summary: Oblivious HTTP lets a client send encrypted HTTP requests through a relay to a gateway. The origin server can't link multiple requests to the same client or tell where they came from, and only limited trust is placed in the forwarding nodes. It is useful where a service wants requests without learning who sent them.

eli5.summary: You pass a sealed note to a helper, who hands it to a teacher without knowing what it says. The teacher reads it but never learns who gave it to the helper.

questions: private http requests through a relay
